name: Dependency index storage boundary
problem: Maven and Gradle duplicated local dependency-index I/O and could not add alternate storage without changing selection callers.
how: A core IndexStore get/put interface isolates root-relative index keys from file and remote implementations while adapters retain fallback status handling.

name: Runtime dependency index
problem: Static source analysis cannot reliably identify which tests exercise dynamically loaded Java classes.
how: A Java agent records per-test class loads into a dependency index; selection intersects changed source candidates with those recorded dependencies and uses explicit conservative fallback reasons.
tags:
dynamic analysis
dependency tracking
safe fallback

name: Shadow-mode validation
problem: Test-selection accuracy needs evidence against a target project's real test outcomes before it controls delivery.
how: The validator replays target Maven builds, compares selected tests with standard Surefire and Failsafe outcomes, and reports misses without changing the target build.
tags:
shadow mode
differential testing
ground truth

name: Conservative baseline recovery
problem: Exact dependency-index cache entries can be temporarily unavailable even when a valid history predecessor exists.
how: Selection reuses only a reachable predecessor index and widens the comparison diff from that anchor, preserving safe over-selection.
tags:
cache recovery
safe fallback
version control

name: Bounded mutation replay
problem: Historical regressions alone give incomplete evidence about whether selection catches behavior-changing changes.
how: An opt-in replay introduces bounded synthetic mutations in real parent-child history pairs and judges selection only against confirmed full-suite outcomes.
tags:
mutation testing
historical replay
bounded analysis
